title: B Make and say
text: Liu Jiajia wants to make a poster about changes in our lives. Help her complete the poster. Then give a report on the changes.
In the past, we went to different places on foot.
In the past, we bought things in shops.
There are a lot of changes in our lives. In the past, we ... Now we ...
What do you think is the biggest change in our lives? Is it a good change? Why?
